title: Local Factor Rigidity and Mass–Defect Bounds for Langton’s Ant
description: Ten-factor eventual modes; finite-mass entry at most 12m+212 with sharp slope; polynomial bit-time exact first-J10 macros with complete compressed endpoints and quadratic finite-event deadlines; and the all-input inequality 3(t-s)-26(|B_t|-|B_s|) <= 351 N10(s,t)+322 with sharp additive constant.
